purpose: Teach: ハワイアン/ノーマル/ヤンキー/ハーモニー/ユニオン/ベール/ダイジェスト/レベルアップ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハワイアンの曲を流して下さってるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's put on some Hawaiian music for us.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Light, easy tone like she's sharing a small moment with him. Soft delivery on the opening name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとノーマルなトーストを食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I had regular toast for breakfast today!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush of words. Simple joy without self-consciousness. The pride of small moments shared. Genuine excitement, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔のヤンキー文化のドキュメンタリーを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's watching a documentary about old yanki culture now.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly amused undertone. Not judging—just noticing. Calm, steady pace. A hint of private humor in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと合唱のハーモニーを練習したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I practiced singing harmonies together!
lines.style: Bright, eager without breathlessness. Simple, direct joy. The delight of being included in something adults do. Small authentic laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがEUユニオンのニュースを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's watching the news about the EU now.
lines.style: Gentle, neutral observation. Slight weariness—the rhythm of his changing interests. Not tired of him, just noting the pattern. Steady, warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと白いベール姿の絵本を見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book with a lady in a white veil!
lines.style: Eager, bright. Direct, simple joy. The excitement of having Dad's attention and sharing something curious. Genuine wonder, no self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが大河ドラマのダイジェスト版を観られたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's just finished watching a digest of the latest historical drama.
lines.style: Calm, gentle observation. A hint of affectionate resignation—he cycles through interests. Warm, patient tone. Slight trailing-off, accepting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとゲームのレベルアップを楽しんだよ
lines.en: Mom, I had so much fun leveling up in that game with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, direct, eager without rushing. Simple authentic joy. The satisfaction of achievement shared. Warmth and pride layered together, genuine.
